scope: pure reconstruction-loss contract for a future factorized canonical field

fixed_design.amplitude_loss: SmoothL1 of predicted log L2 norm and target log_amplitude
fixed_design.amplitude_row_weight: observation_evidence divided by one plus log_amplitude_std
fixed_design.visibility_purity_use: preserved as a separate readout scalar and not folded into reconstruction weighting
fixed_design.invalid_policy: invalid rows contribute exactly zero and at least one valid row is required
fixed_design.schema_policy: ordered factorized reliability scalar names and digest must match exactly

required_tests: direction and amplitude errors are independently measurable
uniform positive scaling only changes the amplitude term when the target is not scaled
invalid rows do not affect either loss
zero predicted vectors produce finite losses and gradients
